_note: Every URL in this file was fetched and confirmed to resolve on 2026-09-11. scope 'topic' means the page is about the entry's subject or its field; scope 'general' means a homepage, portal, collection search or index list, which is kept as background reading but never counts as evidence for a specific entry. An entry whose sources are all general carries the literal string 'source_required' instead of an invented citation. Earlier rejections, kept for the record: si.edu/spotlight/history-of-flight and britannica.com/topic/origins-of-agriculture returned 404 on 2026-09-09.

tiers.C: Crowd-edited encyclopedia pages read for topic context only (Wikipedia). Never counted as item-specific evidence.
